Container.Name: flyvpn-control
Container.Overview:
Web panel + Telegram bot to control invilso/fly-vpn from your server: spin up an ephemeral Tailscale exit node on Fly.io in any of 18 regions and switch country fast (tap a flag). The server only orchestrates — your phones use the Tailscale app to select the auto-approved exit node. Great for "Netflix in another country, now."
Requires a Fly.io API token and a Tailscale OAuth client (Auth Keys Write + Devices Core Write for tag:ephemeral-vpn, Policy File Write). Telegram bot is optional. After each country switch, re-pick the exit node in the Tailscale app on your devices (fly-vpn is one-node-at-a-time today).
Visit /healthz to verify your tokens and scopes.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web control panel.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the fly-vpn usage/stats database.

Config.Name: FLY_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: Fly.io API token (flyctl tokens create org -o personal).

Config.Name: TS_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Tailscale OAuth client ID. Scopes: Auth Keys Write + Devices Core Write (tag:ephemeral-vpn), Policy File Write.

Config.Name: TAILSCALE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Legacy: Tailscale Admin API key (expires after 90 days). Used only if the OAuth client is not set.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather to enable the bot.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_IDS
Config.Description: Optional but recommended. Comma-separated Telegram chat IDs allowed to control the VPN.

Config.Name: VM_MEMORY
Config.Description: Memory (MB) for the Fly exit-node machine.

Config.Name: MAX_NODE_HOURS
Config.Description: Auto-stop the exit node after this many hours (cost safety net; 0 = never).

Config.Name: TS_LOGIN_SERVER
Config.Description: Optional. Headscale server URL for self-hosted control servers.
